name: Yumemiru Koi no Musubikata
source:
There is a shrine which is said to bring romance called Ataragi Shrine. At the shrine stands a cherry tree, which always blooms in summer, inside the shrine. The local legend says if a boy and a girl tie a string on a branch of the tree together, they'll be happy forever. 

One day, when Tomoya visits the shrine with Taiki, his friend, they meet a girl, Sasaya, in a miko's uniform. She is actually his classmate. Days later, when he bumps into her in front of his house, Sasaya suddenly says to him, "I... love you...." Also, three different girls, Asuka, Emiri and Koeda, suddenly start approaching him at the same time. 

Is it just a coincidence? Or is it because of the cherry tree? Like this, Tomoya's life dramatically changes....

[From Erogeshop]
translation:
有一座据说能够带来姻缘的神社，名叫新木神社。境内长着一棵即使在夏季也会盛开的樱树。当地传说，只要一对男女共同把绳结系在树枝上，两人便会永远幸福。

一天，智也与朋友大树来到神社，遇见了一名身穿巫女服的少女笹弥。她其实是智也的同班同学。几天后，智也在家门前偶遇她，笹弥突然说道：“我…喜欢你…”与此同时，飞鸟、绘美里和小枝三名少女也突然一起开始接近他。

这只是巧合，还是樱树的力量？就这样，智也的人生发生了翻天覆地的变化…

[摘自ErogeShop]
